shots.description: A globe eases into the live city model, with Pune's real buildings spread across the frame.
The camera pulls away from the compact core until the full urban map is visible.
The present buildings recede as the Mula and Mutha river lines brighten around the early core.
A small polygon marks the approximate early settlement around the real river lines and landmark positions.
The view rises from the junction to reveal the river-shaped ground around the compact core.
The compact core fills the frame as an attributed historical layer appears over the old centre.
The capital layer consolidates over the old centre and the surrounding river bend.
A close local view follows the river bend and the compact group of landmarks around the old centre.
The small core transforms into the larger Maratha capital extent while the real river lines remain visible.
The capital extent remains highlighted in a broad view of the river-defined city.
The capital extent changes into a wider colonial city, with the eastern cantonment singled out.
The camera travels across the broad colonial-era extent toward its eastern margin.
A moving wide shot contrasts the compact centre with the newer outer city footprint.
The university site appears as the institutional urban extent expands around it.
The view returns toward the old centre, where the river lines converge beneath the larger city.
Blue water runs through the streets of the old centre, following the real river direction into the core.
The old centre darkens beneath the surrounding real building outlines after the flood passage.
The camera leaves the close flood passage and follows the water back toward the river junction.
The camera rises above the river junction and reveals the larger city waiting beyond it.
A wide view links the eastern cantonment with the institutions distributed across the modern city.
A bright marker appears within the present-day building model as the modern street pattern fills the frame.
The present-day building model expands across the frame, contrasting with the earlier compact core.
The camera crosses the full city and follows the Mula-Mutha course through today's urban extent.
The camera reaches a high view in which the whole modern city, rivers, and institutional sites share one frame.
The viewpoint returns to the opening framing, restoring the complete live city model.
Historic extent polygons and today's buildings overlap across the same real-world map.
Concentric rings settle over the complete city as the view holds at the opening position.

lines: The whole city glows on the live map
How did this city take shape?
Pune sits where Mula and Mutha meet
The small outlined core glows clearly
What shaped this city’s early outline?
According to the account:
Pune rose as Bhonsle capital
Records say Pune was capital from 1714.
The camera settles over the old centre
The lit footprint widens beyond the core
Pune served as the seasonal
capital of Bombay Presidency
The British took Pune in 1817
Light reaches the map’s eastern edge
The camera glides along
the expanded city edge
The University of Pune dates to 1948
What changes along the glowing map lines?
Panshet Dam collapsed in 1961, washing
away much of old Pune.
The camera pauses over the old centre
Water threads through the lowest streets
What rises after the water recedes?
Pune hosts the southern
command headquarters
A bright local marker anchors today's map
Today’s streets fill every lit edge
The same rivers are visible
The map holds the whole present city
The whole city returns to the opening view
Old and new shapes share the same map
Putting down roots here,
one brick at a time.
